data.content: injuries continue to slow him down? [...] After making a run at first-time All-Star honors in 2024-25, Franz Wagner somewhat disappointed in 2025-26, though that had a lot to do with injuries - primarily a high-ankle sprain - that forced him to miss 48 games on the campaign. As if the ankle sprain wasn’t bad enough, Wagner would then miss three of the Orlando Magic’s four playoff games last year due to a calf strain, so all in all, it was pretty much a lost season for the German wing. [...] Injuries hampered his output and ended his season early in the Western Conference Finals against the San Antonio Spurs, but the crafty lefty with pull-up scoring ability was a beast in the first two rounds of the postseason, averaging 18.8 points, 4.0 rebounds and 4.9 assists on 47.1 percent shooting in eight games against the Phoenix Suns and Los Angeles Lakers.
